findings.evidence: `roadmap/.../EventGeneration/Suggested.lean:359`: `{s | (∀ i, t < s i ∧ s i < T) ∧ ∀ i j, i < j → s j < s i}` vs `code/.../OrderedSimplexIntegral.lean:195`: `{p | StrictMono p ∧ ∀ i, p i ∈ Set.Ioo t T}`. `grep -n 'StrictAnti' OrderedSimplexIntegral.lean` hits only `preimage_comp_rev_orderedRegion` (line 387), which carries no product integrand and no link to `orderedProdIntegral`.
findings.fix: Add the descending corollary in OrderedSimplexIntegral.lean — rewrite with `← preimage_comp_rev_orderedRegion`, apply `setIntegral_preimage_comp_rev_orderedRegion`, close the reindexing with `Equiv.prod_comp Fin.revPerm (fun i => f (q i))`, then `setIntegral_orderedRegion_eq_orderedProdIntegral` — and point both docstrings at it; otherwise state in both docstrings that the proved identity lists coordinates ascending.
findings.issue: The docstring says the identification of `orderedProdIntegral` with "the Lebesgue integral of the product over the ordered subset of ℝ^n" is `setIntegral_orderedRegion_eq_orderedProdIntegral`. The subset this module displays (line 55) is `{T > t₁ > ⋯ > tₙ > t}` (descending, the roadmap's `orderedRegion` at EventGeneration/Suggested.lean:358), but the cited theorem is over `orderedRegion T n t = {p | StrictMono p ∧ ∀ i, p i ∈ Ioo t T}` (OrderedSimplexIntegral.lean:194), a different set in ℝⁿ. The PR supplies the reversal lemmas but never completes the composite: nothing proves `∫ p in {p | StrictAnti p ∧ ∀ i, p i ∈ Ioo t T}, ∏ i, f (p i) = orderedProdIntegral f T n t`. Same overstatement at EpsilonEridani/Generator/Shower.lean:40-41, which cites the same theorem as proving the Phase-2 ordered-integral identity.

summary: The new theorems are mathematically faithful as stated, but they are about the ascending region `t < p 0 < ⋯ < p (n-1) < T`, while the Sudakov and Generator docstrings advertise them as the identification for the descending region `T > t₁ > ⋯ > tₙ > t` that those modules display; no theorem in the repo states that descending form for the product integrand.
